infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: GK WhizWheel requires camera access to photograph your Indian Driving License and Aadhaar document for KYC verification, as well as take vehicle condition photos during station bike handover.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: GK WhizWheel requires photo library access to upload existing photos or scans of your Driving License and Aadhaar document for KYC approval.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: GK WhizWheel requires your location to identify the nearest rental station hub in Honnavar, calculate travel distances, and provide station platform directions.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: GK WhizWheel uses your location to dispatch 24/7 roadside assistance teams accurately across coastal Karnataka.

plugins.cameraPermission: GK WhizWheel requires camera access to photograph your Indian Driving License and vehicle condition during handover.
